title: HM HUB beta
features:
HM HUB — The Ultimate All-in-One Script for Slasher & Survivor Games!**

Dominate every match with **HM HUB** — the most powerful, user-friendly, and feature-packed script designed for killer-focused games.

---

### ⚡ **Key Features:**

#### 🟡 **Main Tab — Generator Control**
- Teleport to any random generator instantly.
- Auto-repair generators with one click.
- ESP to easily locate all generators on the map.

#### 🟢🔴 **Visual Tab — Player Awareness**
- Highlight all Survivors in green.
- Highlight all Killers in red.
- Clean, minimal visuals for maximum clarity.

#### ⚔️ **Combat Tab — Killer’s Arsenal**
- **Smart Hitbox Killer**: Point at a nearby Survivor → Instantly eliminate them.
- **Auto Carry**: Grab the closest Survivor with a single button.
- **Auto Grab**: Automatically pick up Survivors as you approach.
- **Auto Hook**: Teleport to a random hook and hang your victim instantly.
- **Anti-Stun**: Break free from stuns the moment they happen.
- **Anti-Shake**: Disable screen shake effects for smoother gameplay.

---

### 🎯 **Why Choose HM HUB?**

- 💡 **Simple & Intuitive UI** — Powered by Orion Library.
- 🔄 **Fully Dynamic** — Automatically detects new generators, hooks, and players.
- ⚡ **Lightweight & Fast** — No lag, no crashes.
- 💾 **Auto-Save Settings** — Your preferences stay saved between sessions.

---

### 📥 **How to Use:**

1. Paste the script into your favorite executor (Synapse X, Fluxus, Script-Ware, etc.).
2. Execute.
3. Open the HM HUB menu and start dominating!

---

### ❤️ **Support & Feedback:**

Enjoying HM HUB? Drop a like or share with friends!  
Found a bug or have a suggestion? Let me know — your feedback shapes the next update!

---

🎯 **HM HUB — Play Smarter. Hunt Better. Win Always.**
